bear_assumptions: Approximately 20x guided-equivalent earnings as China and global capital spending weaken, foreign exchange is less helpful, and competitive pricing limits margin conversion.
base_assumptions: Approximately 30x guided-equivalent earnings as raised FY2026 guidance is broadly delivered, conventional automation demand grows, and margins remain near normalized strong levels.
bull_assumptions: Approximately 40x guided-equivalent earnings as broad automation demand, physical-AI adoption, service mix, and operating margins exceed the revised plan.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh scenarios clear expected-return, base-upside, downside-payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence, relationship, and liquidity gates with current primary evidence; downgrade if guidance, margins, China demand, competitive position, foreign exchange, or Frankfurt liquidity deteriorates.
